items.title: European Commission attacked with the help of artificial intelligence
items.originalTitle: 2026. 11. 20. Mesterséges intelligenciával támadták az Európai Bizottságot Az Európai Bizottság megerősítette, hogy októberben kibertámadás érte. A támadók nyilvánosan elérhető MI-eszközt használtak.…
items.summary: The European Commission confirmed an October cyberattack in which attackers leveraged a publicly available AI tool. Details remain limited, but it signals AI-assisted intrusion against EU institutions.

items.title: Microsoft Agent Framework PyPI package compromised
items.originalTitle: 2026. 11. 20. Támadás érte a Microsoft Agent Framework PyPI csomagtárolóját A támadók kompromittálták a Microsoft hivatalos Agent Framework Python-csomagját, és annak két rosszindulatú változatát tet…
items.summary: Attackers compromised Microsoft's official Agent Framework Python package on PyPI and published two malicious versions. Organisations using the package should audit dependencies and pinned versions.

items.title: 2026-022: Critical vulnerabilities in Nginx
items.summary: F5 disclosed five NGINX vulnerabilities allowing unauthenticated remote code execution as the worker process. A PoC exists for CVE-2026-123007; CERT-EU urges prioritising internet-facing systems.

items.title: China's 'Armory Castle' Lays Siege to VMware vCenter Zero-Day
items.summary: A China-nexus group dubbed 'Armory Castle' is exploiting a VMware vCenter zero-day, apparently held in reserve during the previous patch cycle. vCenter operators should verify patch status and hunt for compromise.

items.title: Bell Canada says 'agentic' hacker stole enterprise customer data
items.summary: Bell Canada confirmed an 'agentic' threat actor breached its systems on 17 November 2026 and stole enterprise customer data, including from a telecom circuit ordering and provisioning system.

items.title: Hackers use autonomous AI tool Cairn to find zero-day, take over server
items.summary: Threat actors used the open-source autonomous AI pentest framework Cairn to discover an unknown vulnerability in a medical imaging application and take over a server.

items.title: Amazon says Chinese hackers used Cairn AI tool to discover apparent zero-day during attack on university
items.summary: Amazon researchers report a China-linked actor used the open-source AI pentesting tool Cairn against two universities, in one case apparently discovering a zero-day.

items.title: China attackers deployed AI agents that autonomously found and exploited a 0-day to take over a university server
items.summary: Amazon's CISO says Chinese attackers ran AI agents that autonomously found and exploited a zero-day to compromise a university server, adapting for nearly a day without human direction.

items.title: CISA Adds Four Known Exploited Vulnerabilities to Catalog
items.summary: CISA added four actively exploited CVEs to the KEV catalog: SAP NetWeaver, Cisco Expressway hard-coded credentials, VMware vCenter authentication bypass and Apache Roller deserialization.

items.title: Firewall flaws, AI attacks and data exposure: weekly threat roundup
items.originalTitle: 2026. 11. 20. Tűzfalhibák, AI-támadások és adatkitettség A hét kiemelt fenyegetései között egy aktívan kihasznált Check Point-támadási lánc, az ASUS vállalati felügyeleti szoftverének kritikus hibái…
items.summary: Hungarian NCSC weekly summary highlights an actively exploited Check Point attack chain, critical flaws in ASUS enterprise management software and AI-related incidents.

items.title: 2026-021: High Severity Vulnerability in Java SE and OpenJDK
items.summary: Oracle and OpenJDK fixed CVE-2026-114938, a high-severity flaw that can lead to unauthenticated RCE under certain conditions. CERT-EU recommends patching internet-facing Java applications first.

items.title: 2026-020: Critical Vulnerabilities in Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway
items.summary: Citrix patched 28 memory flaws in NetScaler ADC and Gateway; CVE-2026-120868 affects all deployments including default configurations, with DoS and unpredictable behaviour impact. No exploitation reported.

items.title: FBI's criminal information database hacked, CNN reports
items.summary: CNN reports that an FBI criminal information database was hacked. No technical details confirmed in the item.

items.title: Dialing for Data: Inside the Com’s High-Profile Heists
items.summary: Unit 42 details 'the Com' affiliate campaigns using vishing for initial access, followed by cloud data theft and extortion against healthcare and finance, with defensive guidance.

items.title: Signal slams door on prying AI agents to protect privacy
items.summary: Signal is blocking AI agents from reading its content and criticises Apple, Google and Microsoft for insufficient developer controls over OS-level AI agents.

items.title: Signal blocks Apple, Google AI screenshotting in response to ‘existential threat’ to privacy app
items.summary: Signal will block Apple and Google AI screenshotting by default, calling OS-level AI capture an existential threat to private messaging, following earlier action against Microsoft.

items.title: WhatsApp Patches 3 Security Flaws, Including Android Bug Suspected of Use in Scams
items.summary: WhatsApp fixed three flaws, including CVE-2026-23871 in the Android app (incomplete validation of ad-reply URLs) suspected of abuse in scam messaging. Users should update to 2.26.17.4 or later.

items.title: Daily summary - 20 November 2026 (CERT.at)
items.summary: CERT.at daily report flags ASUS Control Center Express critical hard-coded key flaw (fixed in v1.7.29) and critical Synology NAS vulnerabilities enabling data theft.

items.title: Bazuka Android Malware Uses Fake Screen Overlays to Hide Credential Theft and Device Control
items.summary: ThreatFabric detailed Bazuka, a new Android malware framework using fake overlays for credential theft and device control, with LLM integration for large-scale victim management.

items.title: Tusk: Russian cruise missile incursion into Poland seems ‘intentional’
items.summary: Polish PM Tusk said a Russian cruise missile incursion into Poland appears intentional, raising NATO-border escalation risk relevant to critical infrastructure operators.

items.title: ‘Staff deserve answers’ on Commission cyberattack, union says
items.summary: A staff union says the European Commission has not sent a single all-staff update about the recent cyberattack, criticising its incident communication.

items.title: 354 dark web vendors and buyers arrested in Europol-coordinated global crackdown
items.summary: Operation TorNado, coordinated by Europol across 14 countries, led to 354 arrests of dark web vendors and buyers linked to cybercrime, drugs and firearms between May 2025 and October 2026.

items.title: Denmark expels Russian diplomat over alleged plot to kill Ukrainian rapper
items.summary: Denmark expelled a Russian diplomat over an alleged plot with a banned local gang to assassinate a Ukrainian rapper, part of a broader hybrid threat pattern in Europe.

items.title: Europeans, with Ukraine’s help, brace for more Russian attacks
items.summary: European states, supported by Ukraine, are preparing for further Russian attacks while US rhetoric downplays Russian missiles landing in Poland.

items.title: CTO of ‘RansomwareHelp’ Indicted for Wire Fraud
items.summary: The CTO of ransomwarehelp.com was indicted for wire fraud after an FBI sting showed the firm simply paid ransoms and resold decryption keys at a markup while claiming advanced recovery capabilities.

items.title: CrowdStrike in talks to acquire Zscaler, sources say
items.summary: Sources say CrowdStrike is in talks to acquire Zscaler, a deal that would reshape the endpoint and SSE vendor landscape.

items.title: UK finds fix for fridge and freezer vulnerability after European hacks
items.summary: UK authorities identified a fix for a vulnerability in connected fridges and freezers following hacks in Europe, highlighting consumer IoT exposure.

items.title: Trump says US to penalize firms building data centers abroad
items.summary: Trump said the US would penalise companies that build data centres abroad, a potential factor for European cloud and hosting investment plans.

items.title: Visa, Mastercard theft included info useful for phishing, but not draining bank accounts, say researchers
items.summary: Researchers say data stolen in the Visa/Mastercard-related theft contains information useful for phishing and social engineering, but no financial details enabling direct account draining.

items.title: US companies’ use of Chinese open weight AI draws rebuke from House chairmen
items.summary: A US House Homeland Security Committee investigation criticises US companies' use of low-cost Chinese open-weight AI models in certain projects.

items.title: Latvian leader calls for closure of EU borders to all Russians
items.summary: A Latvian leader called for closing EU borders to all Russian citizens, arguing screening is infeasible as Moscow escalates hybrid attacks.

items.title: Metasploit Wrap Up: Breaking Zimbra's Identity Boundaries
items.summary: Metasploit added a shared Zimbra HTTP mixin and new modules targeting identity-boundary issues from Rapid7 research, lowering the bar for exploitation of unpatched Zimbra servers.

items.title: Token fraud is here and it’s BAD (YouTube)
items.summary: ChatPRD's founder describes large-scale token fraud, with groups abusing free trials to obtain and resell AI tokens or run commercial services on top of the product.

items.title: UK lawmakers question Big Tech representatives on OSA compliance work
items.summary: UK lawmakers questioned Big Tech representatives about their compliance work under the Online Safety Act. Relevant for platform and content governance teams.

items.title: A view from DC: Navigating the California and Colorado ADMT rules
items.summary: Analysis of California and Colorado rules on automated decision-making technology, relevant for organisations deploying AI-driven profiling in the US.

items.title: Zelensky says Putin is a 'killer' after Trump calls Russian leader a friend
items.summary: Zelensky called Putin a 'killer' after Trump described the Russian leader as a friend, underscoring transatlantic tension over Russia policy.

items.title: Al Jazeera explains: The US-China AI race is entering a new phase
items.summary: Explainer on the next phase of the US-China artificial intelligence competition.

items.title: Saudi-led coalition intercepts three Houthi missiles headed for Riyadh
items.summary: Saudi-led coalition intercepted three Houthi missiles aimed at Riyadh as the Houthis threaten ports and power infrastructure.

items.title: Gen Z protests sweep Europe over wars, rising costs and climate
items.summary: Gen Z protests over living costs, military spending and climate took place across 25 European countries; potential for disruption and physical security impacts.

items.title: Hackers breached US Department of Agriculture, NBC News reports
items.summary: NBC News reports hackers breached the US Department of Agriculture. No further technical detail provided.

items.title: Jensen Huang’s ‘Lying’ Alarmed Nvidia Board Ahead of His Resignation
items.summary: WIRED reports the Nvidia board's chief concern before Jensen Huang's resignation was a lack of candor, amid allegations including a relationship with an alleged Chinese intelligence asset.

items.title: The biggest winners and losers of the EU-UK summit deals
items.summary: Analysis of winners and losers from three new agreements signed at the EU-UK summit.

items.title: Tanker catches fire after projectile strike near Strait of Hormuz, UKMTO says
items.summary: UKMTO reports a tanker caught fire after a projectile strike near the Strait of Hormuz, raising shipping and energy risk.

items.title: Marine Le Pen’s party faces scrutiny over alleged leaks from interior ministry
items.summary: A senior French civil servant is under investigation for allegedly leaking confidential judicial information to Marine Le Pen's National Rally.

items.title: Combatting adversarial distillation
items.summary: OpenAI describes its layered defences against adversarial distillation, combining training measures, safeguards, detection and enforcement to prevent capability extraction.

items.title: Apache Roller Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
items.summary: Apache Roller contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via the XML-RPC endpoint, which accepts and deserializes vendor extension types before authentication. This CVE covers the same underlying vulnerability as CVE-2026-82384 bu…

items.title: VMWare vCenter Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability
items.summary: Broadcom VMware vCenter contains an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel vulnerability in the VMware Directory Service that allows an unauthenticated attacker with network access to vCenter to bypass authentication and gain unauthorized access to the system.

items.title: Cisco Expressway Series Use of Hard-coded Credentials Vulnerability
items.summary: Cisco Expressway Series contains a use of hard-coded credentials vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated, remote attacker with persistent cookies and network access to execute commands as root on a clustered device via the database service.

items.title: SAP NetWeaver Improper Neutralization of Special Elements in Data Query Logic Vulnerability
items.summary: SAP NetWeaver Enterprise Portal contains an improper neutralization of special elements in data query logic vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker to disclose or modify server information via injected JNDI environment properties or a URL used during JNDI lookup operations.

items.title: Missing login rate limiting in LessPass backend
items.summary: LessPass self-hosted sync server backends before commit 9469b0cb90b5a79e2ab4f7f07bb67318dd312b99 do not rate-limit JWT login requests. An unauthenticated remote attacker can make unlimited authentication attempts and may obtain tokens with read and write access to stored profiles if account credentials are successfull…
items.mitigation: Update LessPass to commit 9469b0cb90b5a79e2ab4f7f07bb67318dd312b99 or a later release containing it. Until updated, restrict public access to the login endpoints and apply rate limiting at a reverse proxy or gateway.
